context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only TestNotariumIteration9Features::test_email_history_accepts_equivalent_uppercase_object_id after the server query is changed. The test now explicitly compares lowercase and uppercase row counts and row IDs. The sent/failed-both-logged regression passed.

Stored entry_id values are lowercase, so uppercase route text cannot match. Current source lines 1005-1007 confirm the filter still uses entry_id rather than str(entry_oid).
